caption: What if you could press one button and every mosquito on Earth vanished? There are about 3,500 species of mosquitoes. Malaria, spread by mosquitoes, killed an estimated 610,000 people in 2024, according to the WHO, most of them young children. But mosquitoes are also food: fish like the mosquitofish eat their larvae, and in the Arctic, huge summer swarms feed birds. A few orchids even rely on mosquitoes as their main pollinators. Still, many scientists think other insects would quickly fill the gap. And here's the twist: only female mosquitoes bite, because they need blood to make eggs. Males just drink nectar. Only a small share of species bite humans at all. Would YOU press the button? 👇
